description: A `<request>` whose body calls a CLIENT function that reaches a server function (it waits): the request loads user 1 on mount, and a change of its inferred dependency @userId re-fetches user 2 (real SQLite).
rationale: §6.7.7: "When absent, the compiler infers reactive dependencies from `@variable` reads within the fetch expression" + "The fetch re-executes when: Any inferred `@variable` dependency changes"; §13.2: the author writes no asynchrony.
